citations.quote: TREMFYA (guselkumab) injection, for subcutaneous use is a human monoclonal IgG1\lambda antibody that selectively binds to the p19 subunit of human interleukin 23 (IL-23), and inhibits its interaction with the IL-23 receptor.

Guselkumab targets the p19 protein subunit of extracellular human interleukin 23 (IL-23) and blocks the binding of IL-23 to the IL-23 receptor, leading to the reduction and/or inhibition of downstream production of IL-17A, a pro-inflammatory cytokine implicated in psoriasis pathogenesis.
